summary: Created page with "'''Jake Ducey''' (born July 16, 1991) is an American author, motivational speaker, and online personality. Known predominantly for his self-help books and motivational seminars, Ducey has garnered attention for his controversial stance on various conspiracy theories.   In 2021, Ducey joined with Alex Jones to mastermind '''Reset Wars''', Alex's self-proclaimed best work of his life. The video series was a complete failure and wasn't marketed beyond its launch date."
